output_text:
I have built the 3D marble run scene in `scene.js` following the recipe:

- **Two-stage ramp from behind start via center height `0.36` to the cup rim**: An upper ramp section from `[-0.95, 0.66, -0.34]` to `[0.0, 0.36, 0.0]` and a lower ramp section from `[0.0, 0.36, 0.0]` to `[0.735, 0.062, 0.275]` at the cup's front rim.
- **Tall containment walls**: Four `0.065 m`-tall side walls along both ramp sections, flaring wider at the start to capture all initial drop offsets and velocities and extending alongside the cup rim to contain the marble during table bumps.
- **Funnel walls behind the cup**: Two V-shaped backstop walls wrapping around the back of the cup (`[0.8, 0, 0.3]`) to catch incoming marbles at full speed and deflect any bump kicks back into the cup.

The design uses 8 static pieces, 0 paddles, and `0.3929 m^2` of material (within the `0.40 m^2` budget), passing all 4 smoke trials as well as 600/600 additional test seeds.

SMOKE=4/4
